## 🐛 Fixes
- **Buttons stopped working after unlocking with your PIN.** With the app lock on, once you unlocked the app, every button that opens a screen, dialog or form did nothing. Only the bottom tabs still worked. Fixed.
- **Untitled transactions now follow the app language.** A transaction saved without a description is shown as "Transaction" or "معاملة" depending on the current language. Before, it kept the language it was saved in. Ones saved before this update keep their old title.
- **Dates read correctly in Arabic.** The transaction list now shows "1 أكتوبر 2026" instead of "أكتوبر 1, 2026".
- **Category list matches the type.** When adding a transaction, an expense only offers expense categories and an income only offers income ones.
- Recurring income is marked with an up arrow, the same as income everywhere else.

## 📦 Ready for F-Droid
- Pocket Sense is now free software under the **GNU GPL v3 (or later)**.
- F-Droid can build it from source and sign it with its own key.
- Store listing in English and Arabic.

## Download
**Android**
- **`PocketSense-v2.0.1-arm64-v8a.apk`**: almost all modern Android phones. Use this one if unsure.
- `PocketSense-v2.0.1-armeabi-v7a.apk`: older 32-bit phones
- `PocketSense-v2.0.1-x86_64.apk`: emulators and Chromebooks

Installs as an update over v2.0.0 and keeps your data.

**Linux (x86_64)**
- `PocketSense-v2.0.1-linux-x64.tar.gz`. Unpack it and run `./PocketSense/pocket_sense`.
- Needs GTK 3, glibc 2.35 or newer, and a running keyring (GNOME Keyring or KWallet).
